mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS change and 20d forward returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rate and decline in unemployment rate signals an overheating economy triggering aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal from FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling fails to materialize in more than 40% of cases (returns positive in >40% of triggered instances).

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts signals weakening consumer demand and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, a HOUST decline does not produce negative 20d returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment signals strengthening consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between PAYEMS change and 5d forward returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals an extremely tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and central bank intervention, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and industrial production signals a broad-based economic slowdown in consumer demand and manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal from HOUST and INDPRO declining fails to materialize in more than 40% of cases (returns positive in >40% of triggered instances).

mechanism_narrative: During supply chain disruption regimes, a decline in industrial production signals ongoing manufacturing bottlenecks that reduce corporate output and profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In supply chain disruption regimes, an INDPRO decline does not produce negative 60d returns in more than 40% of cases.
